cases.name: Actual PostgreSQL server and delivered source bind
Dry run makes no grant or publication writes
Failure after earlier real DML rolls back and retains consumed 0600 receipt
Two distinct sessions enforce real row-lock waiting
Concurrent same receipt cannot duplicate writes
Applied plan replay is idempotent and global edit preserved
Consumed replay never restores revoked grant
Receipt digest drift and permission-plan publication rejected
Separate approved fixture publication consumes its own receipt

executionNotes: Concurrency harness first required SQLSTATE40001, then observed the delivered consumed-plan refusal against the pre-commit snapshot. The final expectation accepts that exact refusal only with real Lock waiting and exactly one durable grant; product source unchanged.
limits: Local application schema, not deployed cloud schema verification
Temporary fixture data only; no historical permission conversion or publication acceptance
scope: Actual delivered migration functions on local PostgreSQL isolated schema copied from current local application tables, separate sessions; no historical or cloud migration apply
